title: Do More Roles or Larger Models Improve LLM Fact-Checking? A Controlled Study on Fixed Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.29687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A fact-checking system can spend more computation on a claim by using a larger model, by asking the same model several times, or by a multi-role Tribunal: two roles propose quoted findings, code checks the quotations, an auditor that does not see the proposed relation judges each one, and code derives the verdict or abstains. We compare these options on identical fixed evidence, without retrieval: 300 AVeriTeC claims, each with its annotated question--answer items mixed with items written for other claims, read by judges of four open-weights models from three families, a vote of five, and six assignments of models to the Tribunal's roles. The 9B judge was right on 186 claims and the 27B judge of the same family on 156; the larger judges declined to decide far more often and were no more accurate when they decided. translated_title: 更多角色或更大的模型能提升大语言模型的事实核查能力吗？一项基于固定证据的对照研究
translated_abstract: 事实核查系统可以通过多种方式在某个论断上投入更多计算：使用更大的模型、对同一模型多次询问，或采用一个多角色的“法庭”机制——两个角色提出带引文的研究发现，代码检查这些引文，一位看不到所提议关系的审计员对每一项分别评判，最后由代码得出结论或选择弃权。我们在完全相同的固定证据上对这些选项进行比较，且不使用检索：300个AVeriTeC论断，每个论断的标注问答条目与其他论断的条目混合在一起，由来自三个模型家族的四个开放权重模型担任评判者进行阅读，采用五票投票机制，以及六种模型到法庭角色的分配方案。结果显示：9B评判者在186个论断上判断正确，而同一家族的27B评判者仅在156个上正确；更大的评判者拒绝做判断的频率高得多，且在做出判断时准确率也并不更高。投票机制达到196个，而将9B评判者的结论替换为法庭证书后达到195个，两者成本相近；法庭……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 这项对照研究发现，在固定证据下的事实核查中，更大的模型并不能带来更高准确率反而更常拒绝判断，而多角色“法庭”机制的表现与简单投票相当，说明计算资源的分配方式比模型规模更关键。
en_tdlr: A controlled study on fixed evidence shows that larger LLM judges do not improve fact-checking accuracy and abstain more often, while the multi-role Tribunal performs on par with simple voting, indicating that how computation is spent matters more than model size.
